title: Weekly prep: Dedicated capacity GPU forecast & autoscale (1:1)
content:
Objective:
Prep notes for weekly dedicated-capacity sync and 1:1 with PJ — focus on Q2 GPU pool forecast, reservation recommendations, and autoscaling adjustments. Want to leave the meeting with a clear ask for finance (reservation commit) and ops (autoscale tuning + rollout plan).

Summary (top-line):
- Current reserved footprint: 40x A100-40GB, 20x H100-80GB (total 60 GPUs reserved) running across two dedicated pools (eu-west & us-west).
- Average cluster utilization last 30d: ~72% (p90 latency SLO still met for customer workloads).
- Near-term demand: running signals (traffic, new customers onboarding, internal evals) show projected GPU-hour increase of ~20% in next 8 weeks, with peak-day spikes up to +40% on some routes.
- Recommendation: commit to +8 H100 reservations (targeting burst-heavy workloads) and increase pool burst capacity policy; tune autoscaler min/max to better match steady-state vs. spikes.

Details / reasoning:
1) Demand signals and forecast
   - Telemetry: token-per-second and request rate trending up; 7-day MAU for dedicated customers +28% vs prior quarter.
   - New customers onboarding: 3 enterprise deals in pipeline likely to convert in Apr-May (estimated add of ~6 sustained concurrent workers during peak).
   - Lab/eval noise: applied-ml running larger sequence length evals next month (H100-preferred). Should budget for 10-15% additional H100 hours for that.
   - Forecast summary: baseline GPU-hours +20% next 8w; reserve-sensitive peak events could need +40% ephemeral capacity.

2) Current reservations and utilization by model/hardware (last 30d avg)
   - A100-40GB reserved: 40 units, avg utilization 68%, p95 utilization 94% during peaks.
   - H100-80GB reserved: 20 units, avg utilization 82%, p95 utilization 98%.
   - Observations: H100s operate closer to saturation (we rely on H100s for low-latency high-seq workloads and internal evals).

3) Reservation recommendation (ask to finance / BD)
   - Add 8x H100-80GB reserved capacity (bring H100 total to 28). Rationale: improves steady-state capacity for H100-preferred jobs and reduces expensive burst spend.
   - Consider shifting 4x A100 reservations to H100 if contract terms allow a swap (depends on vendor). If swap allowed, net add could be 4 H100 with smaller incremental cost.
   - Commitment: 12-month term preferred for best unit pricing; fallback to 6-month if legal/finance pushes back.
   - Expected outcomes: projected 15-25% reduction in on-demand burst cost for next quarter; improved headroom for evals and new customer onboarding.

4) Autoscaling / policy tuning
   - Current autoscaler (per-pool) settings: min=6 nodes, max=40 nodes, burst multiplier=2.0, cooldown=120s.
   - Problems: slow scale-up under sudden sustained burst (some requests route to fallback models causing higher latency).
   - Proposed changes for primary pools: set min_nodes to 8 for H100 pool (ensures baseline capacity), reduce cooldown to 60s for faster ramp, set burst multiplier to 2.5 for short spikes but enforce token-per-second guardrails to avoid runaway spend.
   - For A100 pool: keep min at 6, reduce max to 30 and rely on cross-pool fallback to H100 when appropriate.
   - Autoscale test plan: run canary for 72h with increased min_nodes/H100 pool in eu-west, measure scale-up time, tail latency, and cost delta.

5) Risk and mitigation
   - Risk: Overcommitting to H100 increases committed spend before customers fully materialize. Mitigation: do 6-mo term if uncertain, include finance checkpoint after 90 days.
   - Risk: Autoscaler tuning could increase on-demand cost if cooldown is too short / burst multiplier too permissive. Mitigation: add guardrails (max hourly spend per pool), alerting on spend anomalies.
   - Risk: Vendor hardware lead time for new H100 reservations (delays). Mitigation: maintain small buffer of on-demand credits and use hosted fallback models for critical SLAs.

6) Open questions for PJ / 1:1
   - Is finance comfortable with the proposed H100 commitment as a Q2 ask? If not, what monthly budget cap would they prefer we target?
   - Are there upcoming enterprise deals we should accelerate to justify longer term commitments? (need list of 2-3 top opportunities).
   - Any constraints from procurement on swapping A100->H100 reservations (contract flexibility)?
   - Prioritization: if we can only add 4 H100 now, do we prioritize eu-west or us-west pool? My recommendation = eu-west (higher current p95 utilization + active onboarding).

7) Action items (owners + target dates)
   - Maya: finalize reservation ask doc (cost delta + justification) and send to finance & BD by 2026-03-05.
   - Liam Chen: run autoscale canary in eu-west H100 pool (min_nodes=8, cooldown=60s, burst=2.5) for 72h; report latency/cost metrics by 2026-03-08.
   - Hannah Kim: surface list of 3 highest-priority enterprise deals and expected start dates; confirm revenue timing by 2026-03-04.
   - Jordan Lee: check procurement contract flex for A100<->H100 swap options and estimated lead times; update by 2026-03-06.
   - Ops/Finance: agree on guardrail thresholds for per-pool hourly spend alerts (proposal attached in linked artifacts) by 2026-03-09.

Notes / quick references:
- Short calculation: adding 8 H100 reserves reduces expected on-demand H100 hours by ~70% across forecasted peak events (rough simulation in spreadsheet linked in CONFLUENCE-DC-forecast).
- If we commit 8 H100 on 12mo terms, projected blended GPU cost per reserved-hour improves by ~18% vs on-demand (see cost sheet).

Meeting goals for sync:
1) Get verbal buy-in from PJ on reservation ask + preferred term length.
2) Align on which pool(s) to target for immediate increases.
3) Approve autoscale canary parameters and owners.
4) Confirm action item owners and due dates.

Appendix (quick runbook notes):
- How to adjust autoscaler in staging: infra/playbooks/autoscaler-adjust.md (internal).
- Important dashboards: Reserved Capacity Dashboard (linked), Per-route latency and model-fallback chart (alerts set at p95>250ms).

End-of-doc.
